# Operation and event index

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_api_reference.py from the port patches. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every operation in the `game.*` catalog and every event either port lists, read from the catalogs in the
port patches. The chapters linked from each heading say how to use them; start at the [API overview](../API.md).

- **381 operations** in 43 domains: 362 supported on Chronicle,
  176 on Chronicle Two, 161 on both.
- Call one as `game.<domain>.<operation>(arguments)` or `moonmod.api.call("<domain>.<operation>", arguments)`.
- **Permission** is what the mod's `mod.json` must list under `permissions`. A dash means none.
- **Phase** is where the call is safe: `any`, `simulation` (during play), `content` (registration) or `ui`.
- **C1** and **C2** say whether Chronicle (Dark Cloud) and Chronicle Two (Dark Chronicle) bind the operation.
  An operation a port does not bind fails with `code = "unsupported"` and a reason.

The running game is the authority: `moonmod.api.list()` and `moonmod.api.supports(path)` report what that
build supports. A few operations also depend on the build (`net.*` needs a network library).

## Operations

### `game.animations`

Written up in [assets.md](assets.md).

| Operation | Permission | Phase | C1 | C2 | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | :-: | :-: | --- |
| `animations.player_register` | `content.register` | simulation | yes | – | Add a mod's own motion (a moonmod-motion JSON file in its resources/) to a Chronicle playable character; it is appended to the character's motions whenever its model loads. |
| `animations.player_unregister` | `content.register` | simulation | yes | – | Take back one of this mod's playable-character motions. |
| `animations.player_list` | `game.read` | simulation | yes | – | This mod's playable-character motions, with the motion number each has on the loaded character. |
| `animations.monster_register` | `content.register` | simulation | yes | – | Add a mod's own motion (a moonmod-motion JSON file in its resources/) to a native monster model, with optional hit spheres; it is appended to the model whenever a floor loads it. |
| `animations.monster_unregister` | `content.register` | simulation | yes | – | Take back one of this mod's monster motions (from the next load of its model). |
| `animations.monster_list` | `game.read` | simulation | yes | – | This mod's monster motions, with the motion number and first frame each has on a loaded floor model. |
| `animations.register` | `content.register` | content | yes | yes | Bind a model-embedded motion index to a stable mod animation id. |
| `animations.play` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | yes | Play a registered animation on a compatible entity. |
| `animations.stop` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | yes | Stop an animation started by this mod. |

### `game.dungeons`

Written up in [dungeons.md](dungeons.md).

| Operation | Permission | Phase | C1 | C2 | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | :-: | :-: | --- |
| `dungeons.list` | `game.read` | any | yes | yes | List native dungeons and mod-registered additions supported by this game. |
| `dungeons.get` | `game.read` | any | yes | yes | Read a native dungeon or registered extension and its floors. |
| `dungeons.register` | `content.register` | content | yes | yes | Register additional floors on a supported native dungeon map. |
| `dungeons.selection` | `game.read` | any | yes | – | Read the active Chronicle entrance floor selection, or nil. |
| `dungeons.set_badges` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Publish owned native floor-list tier badges 0..5. |
| `dungeons.set_modifiers` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Set owned additive generation bonuses in percent (0..300): rooms, monsters, chests, chest_value; {} clears this owner. |
| `dungeons.set_population` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Scale generated monster and chest targets by realized room count using inclusive per-room min/max ratios; native minimums and engine slot limits still apply; {} clears this owner. |
| `dungeons.set_enemy_survival` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Set this mod's chance for eligible ordinary Chronicle enemies to survive one lethal hit; {} clears this owner. |
| `dungeons.set_layout` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | yes | Set room count, room area and room sizes for floors built after the call; an empty table restores the native layout. |
| `dungeons.set_seed` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Build the next new floor from this seed, once (world.get().floor_seed reports a floor's seed); {} lets it pick its own. |
| `dungeons.chests_get` | `game.read` | any | yes | – | List the chests on the player's floor: chest number, large, opened, item_id, x, z (mimics left out). |
| `dungeons.set_opened_chests` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Open these chests (numbers from game.chest.opened) as the next front floor and back floor are built, once; with set_seed a kept floor keeps its opened chests. |
| `dungeons.set_exit_room` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Turn the walk-through exit room on or off for floors built after the call. |
| `dungeons.floor_rules_get` | `game.read` | any | yes | yes | Read active and per-floor dungeon restriction rules such as Limited Zones or White/Red Seals. |
| `dungeons.floor_rules_set` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | yes | Override active or per-floor dungeon restriction rules such as Limited Zones or White/Red Seals. |
| `dungeons.shared_events_get` | `game.read` | simulation | yes | – | Co-op: the scripts this player ran since the last call that changed the floor without leaving it (a door, a gate, a switch), to run for the other players. |
| `dungeons.shared_event_run` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Co-op: run another player's floor-changing script here, at its place, once the player is free; the key it asks for is taken as given. |
| `dungeons.map_snapshot` | `game.read` | simulation | yes | – | The floor the player is on as far as they have seen it: {seed, width, cells, seen}, for ui.map_open and dungeons.set_seen later. |
| `dungeons.set_seen` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Count the cells of a kept map (dungeons.map_snapshot) as seen again on the floor the player is on, when it was built from the same seed. |
| `dungeons.set_waypoint` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Put the red waypoint flag on the mini map at cell x, y of the floor the player is on; {} takes it away. |
| `dungeons.set_character_blocks` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Put only the named characters' own doors and parts (Xiao's jumps, Goro's and Ruby's doors, Ungaga's and Osmond's parts) on new Chronicle floors. |
| `dungeons.set_zones` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Lay Chronicle floors built from now on out as 2-24 zones joined by locked gates; a monster in each zone carries the next gate's key; open lists gates built open; shrines = true puts a spring in each zone's shrine room; a zone's source_floor gives it that floor's monsters, atla and chest items; a zone's source_dungeon builds it from that dungeon's rooms, corridors and pillars and gives it that dungeon's monsters (its main floor pack loads beside the floor's own); exit_floor is where the floor's exit gate leads; smoke lists gates no key opens (game.dungeon.smoke_touched); shrine_heal = false keeps the springs from healing HP; sanctuary = true keeps monsters out of a shrine's circle; {} turns zones off. |
| `dungeons.set_exits` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Keep the party from leaving a Chronicle dungeon for town by the Escape menu or the exit gate (town = "shrines"; the gate leads on), or give the exits back (town = "any"). |
| `dungeons.warp` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Move the player at once to a cell (x, y) of the dungeon floor they are on. |
| `dungeons.drop_token` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Put a bag on the dungeon floor the player is on, at a world position (x, y, z), drawn as the game's own dropped item; walking onto it sends game.dungeon.token_taken {tag} to this mod instead of filling the bag. |
| `dungeons.drop_gilda` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Put a pile of gold (amount) on the dungeon floor the player is on, at a world position (x, y, z); the player takes it by walking onto it. |
| `dungeons.enter_floor` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Build floor floor_id of the current dungeon (or, from a town, of dungeon_id) again from the start (its monsters come back) and enter it, the player arriving at cell x, y when given. |
| `dungeons.set_arrival` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Start the player on the next floor built at cell x, y, or in front of a zone's shrine (zone). |
| `dungeons.zones_get` | `game.read` | any | yes | – | Read the zones asked for, the player's floor's zones, gates (zone, x, y, key, locked, carrier) and shrines (zone, x, y), and the zone the player stands in. |
| `dungeons.set_warden_room` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Seal the room behind each new Chronicle floor's exit gate until every monster outside it is dead, optionally closing it behind the player. |
| `dungeons.warden_room_get` | `game.read` | any | yes | – | Read the current floor's Warden room: state, centre, size. |
| `dungeons.room_seal` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Shut the doorways of the room the player stands in (an ambush). |
| `dungeons.room_release` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Open a room this mod shut. |
| `dungeons.zone_gate_open` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Open the gate into a zone of the floor this mod lays out in zones (a keyed or smoke gate), such as a Warden's way on once it falls. |
| `dungeons.warden_room_release` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Open the Warden room's doors that closed behind the player. |
| `dungeons.set_rest_room` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Build new Chronicle floors as rest floors: a hall with a healing spring and an antechamber with the back floor's stairs, joined by the corridor that holds the way in and the exit. |
| `dungeons.rest_room_get` | `game.read` | any | yes | – | Read the current rest floor: its spring, back floor stairs and hall. |
| `dungeons.set_npc_marks` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Chronicle: {marks = {{npc, x, y, facing}}} stands the floor's own NPCs (loaded with its parts, such as the Fairy King, NPC 0) at cells of the floor the player is on; {} takes them away. |
| `dungeons.set_npc_models` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Chronicle: {models = {{dungeon_id, npc = 1-3, pack = "dun/.../<stem>.chr" or "gedit/...", cfg (default <stem>.cfg; base.cfg for dun/mainchara), motion}}} loads characters into a dungeon's free NPC slots when its map loads, for set_npc_marks to stand; {} stops. |
| `dungeons.play_event` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Chronicle: {program = n} plays program n of the dungeon's event script (a scene) on the floor the player is on, as a monster's script asks for one; game.dungeon.event_ended follows when it is over. |
| `dungeons.set_quick_passage` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Chronicle: {enabled = true} goes between a town and a dungeon with no loading card, only the fades; {enabled = false} gives the card back. |
| `dungeons.set_floor_select` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Chronicle: {enabled = false} turns the dungeon entrance's floor menu off, so it takes the player straight to the first floor; {enabled = true} gives it back. |
| `dungeons.set_story_exits` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Chronicle floors of the game's own design: the gate that asks for the floor's key asks the mod's question (leave this floor?) instead; the gate stays shut and the mod takes the player on (game.dungeon.story_exit). |
| `dungeons.set_backrooms` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Free Chronicle back floors: the stairs ask whether to go down (enter at your own risk) instead of asking for the gate key. |
| `dungeons.set_weapon_drops` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Set the rules for weapons in Chronicle chests: none the party holds, a chance of a stronger one, the share of large chests. |
| `dungeons.chest_weapons_add` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Let Chronicle dungeon chests hold a registered weapon from a dungeon floor on, a percent of the time a chest holds a weapon. |
| `dungeons.chest_weapons_clear` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Take back the chest weapons this mod added. |
| `dungeons.set_shortcuts` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Ask for shortcut doors on each new Chronicle floor: dead ends loop back, locked, with their keys in the dead end. |
| `dungeons.shortcuts_get` | `game.read` | any | yes | – | List the current floor's shortcut doors, their keys and whether each is still locked. |
| `dungeons.floor_redirect` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Send a registered floor's exit gate to another registered floor of the same dungeon (Chronicle). |
| `dungeons.loot_get` | `game.read` | any | yes | yes | Read active floor treasure chest contents and monster drop tables. |
| `dungeons.loot_override` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | yes | Override floor treasure chest contents or monster drop tables. |
| `dungeons.back_floor_get` | `game.read` | any | yes | – | Read Chronicle back-floor state, the active floor gate key, and whether the key is held. |
| `dungeons.back_floor_enter` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Queue Chronicle's native back-floor transition without consuming the gate key. |
| `dungeons.spheda_get` | `game.read` | any | – | yes | Read the active Chronicle Two Spheda challenge, pin, ball, par, and gauge state. |
| `dungeons.spheda_spawn` | `game.write` | simulation | – | yes | Reset and activate the active Chronicle Two Spheda course's pin and ball placement. |
| `dungeons.lighting_get` | `game.read` | any | yes | – | Read the active floor's fog, background and ambient light, front and back side. |
| `dungeons.lighting_set` | `game.write` | simulation | yes | – | Set the active floor's fog, background or ambient light until the next floor loads. |

| `save.account_remove` | `game.write` | any | yes | – | Co-op host: forget a guest's things in this save. |
| `save.migrate` | `game.write` | load | yes | yes | Run an owned save migration at the save-load boundary. |
| `save.autosave_set` | `game.write` | any | yes | – | Enable or disable Chronicle's guarded native autosave writer. |

## Events

The events `game.events.list()` reports. Subscribe with `moonmod.on(name, callback)` or
`game.events.subscribe(name, callback)`. Some operations also send events of their own to the mod that asked
(a panel's answer, a floor's gate); those are described with the operation in its chapter.

| Event | Domain | C1 | C2 | When |
| --- | --- | :-: | :-: | --- |
| `runtime.started` | runtime | yes | yes | The MoonFactory runtime has started. |
| `runtime.stopping` | runtime | yes | yes | The MoonFactory runtime is stopping. |
| `runtime.loaded` | runtime | yes | yes | A mod package has loaded. |
| `runtime.unloaded` | runtime | yes | yes | A mod package has unloaded. |
| `settings.changed` | settings | yes | yes | A setting owned by this mod changed in the manager. |
| `game.player.move` | player | yes | – | A mod move (player.moves_set) started: its id, the mod that set it and the character. |
| `game.dungeon.warden_room` | dungeons | yes | – | The Warden room opened (state open, center) or the player walked in (state entered, center, size, shut). |
| `game.dungeon.backroom` | dungeons | yes | – | The player answered the free back floor's prompt: entered. |
| `game.dungeon.event_ended` | dungeons | yes | – | A scene started with dungeons.play_event is over (to that mod only): program, dungeon_id, floor_id. The floor's monsters are gone after it. |
| `game.dungeon.story_exit` | dungeons | yes | – | The player answered a fixed floor's gate (dungeons.set_story_exits): left, dungeon_id, floor_id. |
| `game.dungeon_npc.near` | world | yes | – | The player walked up to this mod's figure on the dungeon floor: id. |
| `ui.run_menu_action` | ui | yes | – | The player used a row of this mod's run menu: tab and row ids. |
| `ui.run_menu_shown` | ui | yes | – | This mod's run menu opened or closed: open, tab. |
| `ui.choice_made` | ui | yes | – | The player picked an option on this mod's choice panel (index from 1), or backed out (cancelled). |
| `ui.map_choice` | ui | yes | – | The player pressed Cross on a mark of this mod's map screen (mark from 1, x, y); the map has closed. |
| `ui.map_waypoint` | ui | yes | – | The player put (set = true) or took away the waypoint at x, y on this mod's map screen. |
| `ui.map_page` | ui | yes | – | The player pressed L2 (way -1) or R2 (way 1) on this mod's map screen opened with pages = true; open another map to turn the page. |
| `ui.map_closed` | ui | yes | – | This mod's map screen closed. |
| `ui.sky_selected` | ui | yes | – | The player pressed a button on a node of this mod's sky page: id, entry (the node), action (buy, toggle, rank_down, rank_up). |
| `ui.sky_closed` | ui | yes | – | This mod's sky page closed: id. |
| `ui.action` | ui | yes | yes | A manager action owned by this mod was activated. |
| `game.tick` | game | yes | yes | A simulation frame was pumped. |
| `game.scene.will_enter` | scene | yes | yes | A scene is about to initialize. |
| `game.scene.entered` | scene | yes | yes | A scene finished initialization. |
| `game.dungeon.generating` | dungeons | yes | yes | Before a Chronicle procedural floor is generated; dungeon_id, floor_id, back_floor. |
| `game.dungeon.generated` | dungeons | yes | – | A Chronicle procedural floor was built; dungeon_id, floor_id, back_floor, floor_seed (dungeons.set_seed builds it again), room_count. |
| `game.world.location_changed` | world | yes | yes | A world location changed; published at scene initialization when detectable and polled within scenes. |
| `game.item_used` | items | yes | yes | A mod API item-use call completed. |
| `game.player.thirst_changed` | player | yes | yes | The active character's Chronicle water gauge changed, drained empty, or was restored. |
| `game.photo.taken` | photos | yes | yes | Max took a photo; reports its subject, map, and scoop or idea recognition state. |
| `game.invention.created` | inventions | yes | yes | A Chronicle Two invention was discovered in the menu or crafted through the API. |
| `game.spheda.completed` | dungeons | yes | yes | A Chronicle Two Spheda challenge was recorded as cleared. |
| `game.item_given` | items | yes | yes | An item or weapon was added through a MoonFactory grant API. |
| `game.item_picked_up` | items | yes | yes | A native dungeon pickup was added to the player's inventory. |
| `game.item_removed` | items | yes | yes | An item was removed through the MoonFactory inventory API. |
| `game.shop.purchased` | shops | yes | yes | A shop purchase or shop inventory change completed. |
| `game.enemy_spawned` | characters | yes | yes | A registered mod-owned enemy spawned successfully. |
| `game.enemy_defeated` | combat | yes | yes | The game accepted an enemy death. |
| `game.dungeon.zone_entered` | dungeons | yes | – | The player walked into another zone of a zoned floor (or arrived on one): zone, previous (-1 on arrival), zones. |
| `game.dungeon.zone_gate_opened` | dungeons | yes | – | The player opened a zone gate with its key: zone (the zone behind it), key, x, y. |
| `game.dungeon.shrine_reached` | dungeons | yes | – | The player stands in front of a zone's shrine spring (dungeons.set_zones shrines): zone, x, y; once until they walk away. |
| `game.dungeon.defeated` | dungeons | yes | – | The party was knocked out in a dungeon and is about to be sent to town, which halves its Gilda: dungeon_id, floor_id, gilda (before). |
| `game.dungeon.town_refused` | dungeons | yes | – | dungeons.set_exits kept the party from leaving for town: via ("menu" or "gate"). |
| `game.dungeon.zone_gate_locked` | dungeons | yes | – | The player reached a locked zone gate without its key: zone, key, x, y. |
| `game.dungeon.smoke_touched` | dungeons | yes | – | The player walked up to a smoke gate (dungeons.set_zones smoke): zone, x, y; once until they walk away. |
| `game.dungeon.door_opened` | dungeons | yes | – | The player opened a shortcut door with its key: key, x, y. |
| `game.dungeon.token_taken` | dungeons | yes | – | The party walked onto a bag this mod dropped (dungeons.drop_token): tag, x, y, z. |
| `game.dungeon.wall_opened` | dungeons | yes | – | A blow opened an illusory wall: wall (its number on the floor), x, y. |
| `game.dungeon.door_locked` | dungeons | yes | – | The player reached a locked shortcut door without its key: key, x, y. |
| `game.companion.hit` | party | yes | – | The companion's blow landed on an enemy: entity, damage, killed, reward_exp. |
| `game.player.guarded` | player | yes | – | A fatal hit left a character on 1 HP and spent one of its player.fatal_guard charges. |
| `game.player.critical` | player | yes | – | A Chronicle critical move began on an enemy: {id, owner, kind (backstab or riposte), entity, native_model_id, hold}. |
| `game.companion.struck` | party | yes | – | The player's weapon hurt a hostile companion (an invader): {character, damage, hp, max_hp, killed}. |
| `game.player.hit` | player | yes | – | A hit reached the active Chronicle player: {character, entity, kind, damage, incoming, blocked, parried, broke, poised, angle, gauge}. |
| `game.enemy_hit` | combat | yes | yes | A native weapon hit damaged an enemy; includes attacker, weapon, target, model, element, and final damage. |
| `game.weapon.upgraded` | weapons | yes | yes | A native weapon upgrade changed the weapon. |
| `game.weapon.equipped` | weapons | yes | yes | The active weapon changed through a supported API. |
| `game.weapon.menu_action` | weapons | yes | – | The player pressed a mod's button on the weapon menu (weapons.menu_actions_set): {action, id, item_no, character, slot, level, abs, source_mod}. |
| `game.weapon.abs_gained` | weapons | yes | yes | An owned weapon gained ABS experience or synthesis points. |
| `game.weapon.built_up` | weapons | yes | yes | A weapon evolved into a build-up target or synthesized into a sphere/spectol. |
| `game.weapon.broken` | weapons | yes | yes | A weapon broke or was status-broken / spectrumized. |
| `game.chest.opened` | dungeons | yes | yes | The player opened a dungeon chest (dungeon_id, floor_id, back_floor, chest, item_id, large), or a mod updated a loot table. |
| `game.floor.cleared` | dungeons | yes | yes | A dungeon floor was cleared or its restriction rules changed. |
| `game.party.active_changed` | party | yes | yes | The active party member changed through a supported API. |
| `game.party.recruited` | party | yes | yes | A townsperson joined or replaced the current companion. |
| `game.story_flag_changed` | world | yes | yes | A native story flag changed through a supported API. |
| `game.story_value_changed` | world | yes | yes | A native story counter changed through a supported API. |
| `game.map_flag_changed` | world | yes | yes | A native map flag changed through a supported API. |
| `game.georama.request_changed` | georama | yes | yes | A native Georama request changed through a supported API. |
| `game.georama.element_changed` | georama | yes | yes | A native Chronicle plot element changed. |
| `game.georama.atla_collected` | georama | yes | – | Toan picked up a mod's own Atla sphere (georama.atla_spawn). |
| `game.georama.condition_changed` | georama | yes | yes | A Chronicle Two analysis condition changed. |
| `game.georama.request_known_changed` | georama | yes | yes | A Chronicle Two Georama request became known or unknown. |
| `game.georama.river_changed` | georama | yes | yes | A Chronicle Two river cell changed. |
| `game.georama.piece_placed` | georama | yes | yes | A Georama piece was placed. |
| `game.georama.piece_removed` | georama | yes | yes | A Georama piece was removed. |
| `game.npc.talk` | characters | yes | – | The player pressed talk at a town villager the mod registered (characters.register kind = 'npc') that has no native talk event, or at a town resident it hooked (native = true). |
| `game.title.opened` | title | yes | – | The player opened this mod's title mode screen from the title menu. |
| `game.title.selected` | title | yes | – | The player confirmed an entry on this mod's title mode screen, or pressed Circle (entry 'back'). |
| `game.session.started` | session | yes | – | A mod's sandbox session started: a fresh game with no save slot. |
| `game.session.ended` | session | yes | – | A sandbox session ended: reason 'defeat', 'left_dungeon', 'ended' or 'loaded_save'. |
| `quests.started` | quests | yes | yes | A registered quest became active. |
| `quests.objective_advanced` | quests | yes | yes | A quest objective advanced. |
